meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

copy.tagline: 创作或编辑自定义视频合成作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作多场景视频、品牌短片或自由形式的视频合成
copy.tagline_en: Author or edit custom video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create multi-scene videos, brand reels, or freeform video compositions

howto.what: Claude 会根据你的需求创作或编辑视频项目，包括多场景短片、品牌宣传片、蒙太奇、静态循环、标题卡、素材混剪等。它会先规划故事结构，再逐步构建场景、添加动画和媒体，最后生成预览供你审核。
howto.when: 当你需要制作较长或多场景的视频，且没有更专门的流程可用时触发。也适用于品牌宣传片、蒙太奇、静态标题卡等自由创作。

say.text: 帮我做一个30秒的产品宣传视频，展示新手机的功能。
say.note: Claude 会规划故事板并逐步构建视频。

say.text: 把这段素材混剪成一支15秒的蒙太奇，配上背景音乐。
say.note: Claude 会处理素材、添加音乐并生成预览。

say.text: 给这个视频加一个开场标题卡和结尾字幕。
say.note: Claude 会添加标题卡和字幕，并保持风格一致。

howto.what_en: Claude creates or edits custom video compositions for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, and footage remixes. It plans the story, builds scenes, adds animation and media, then generates a preview for approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a longer or multi-scene video and no specialized workflow fits. Also for brand reels, montages, static title cards, and freeform builds.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second product promo video showcasing the new phone's features.
say_en.note: Claude will plan the storyboard and build the video step by step.

say_en.text: Remix this footage into a 15-second montage with background music.
say_en.note: Claude will process the footage, add music, and generate a preview.

say_en.text: Add an opening title card and closing credits to this video.
say_en.note: Claude will add the title card and credits while keeping style consistent.
